items.title: Pay physiotherapy invoice
items.quote: Den Betrag ueberweisen Sie bitte binnen 30 Tagen ab dem oben genannten Rechnungsdatum; als Verwendungszweck genuegt die Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: Start of the period is the invoice date 23.05.2025; under BGB sections 187(1) and 188(1) the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting begins 24.05.2025. 30 days later lands on 22.06.2025 (24 to 31 May = 8 days, plus 22 days in June = 30 days total). 22.06.2025 is a Sunday. This is a private payment deadline owed to a company, so under BGB section 193 the due date shifts to the next working day: Monday 23.06.2025. No public holiday falls in between.
